name: Cache lease + TTL jitter
description: Same as "Cache stampede", with two more settings. Lease: when a hot key expires, the first miss gets a lease and reads the DB; the others ask Redis again every 20 ms until the value is written back. Each expiry reads the DB once: DB load drops from about 61 rps to about 23 rps, and nothing fails. TTL jitter 0.2: keys written together at the start do not all expire at second 10, 20 and 30, so DB peaks are lower and more even. The cost: waiting requests take tens of ms longer.
